events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, "Dr. No," in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' first hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally. What's the Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated English comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday Humour
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From flying circuses to hotel chaos, his genius has given us endless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, universally known as "The White Album," was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Retrospective
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece – what's your standout track from this legendary double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true icon. Remembering the magnificent Freddie Mercury today, whose unparalleled showmanship and voice continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Reflection
angles.copy: Fifty-nine years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – an album that pushed boundaries and showcased their evolving sound. Which track from 'Rubber Soul' still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the music world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a voice that changed the world. Remembering John Lennon, whose legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on. What's the Lennon song that moves you most?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The visionary artist David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie Birthday Celebration
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the extraordinary life and artistry of David Bowie. His influence remains as boundless as his imagination. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935 in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: Elvis Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Happy heavenly 92nd birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley! His voice, his moves, his legacy – forever iconic. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday Rock
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll history. What's the Led Zeppelin track that showcases his genius best?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday Celebration
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to solo superstardom, his distinctive voice is instantly recognisable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday Skank
angles.copy: One step beyond and 66 years young! Happy birthday to the legendary Suggs from Madness. What's the Madness track that always gets you skanking?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," was born on this day in 1956.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday Flashback
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the voice behind some of the 80s' biggest hits, Paul Young! Which of his classic tracks takes you back?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The iconic country music legend, singer-songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. A true queen of country and an inspiration to millions. What's your favourite Dolly moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow was born on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday Pop
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From pop anthems to powerful ballads, his songwriting legacy is undeniable. What's your favourite Gary Barlow or Take That track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, was born on this day in 1950.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday Groove
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Caribbean Queen' your way to a happy 77th birthday for Billy Ocean! His smooth vocals defined an era. What's your favourite Billy Ocean classic?
